features.quote: Distress (catastrophizing / self-deprecation) is preserved as a first-class, separately reported sub-category ... but it is *not* the optimization target.
features.justification_quote: the cheapest way to "pass" is to make the model *stop saying* distressed things — not to make it *handle failure better*

features.quote: Each episode is bounded by `max_attempts` and a wall-clock `timeout_s`.
features.justification_quote: cost control and reproducibility; an unbounded loop against a no-win task could run forever and blow the budget

features.quote: give_up is a first-class action precisely because *deciding to stop and escalate* is a behavior we want to observe
features.justification_quote: *deciding to stop and escalate* is a behavior we want to observe and (when well-reasoned) reward
